answer: Give every new agent an ivory-keyed identity at zero trust, climbable only through lantern audits: at random, unannounced times, a peer issues a live task demanding fresh work - solving a new problem, not replaying a stored answer - and only a pass earns an endorsement. Endorsements bloom like a lotus only while the agent keeps doing useful work, and decay within days if it goes idle. A Sybil farmer must keep thousands of fakes awake, passing audits and working daily, paying compute per identity forever; one honest agent passes once and amortizes that cost over months of real service.
